instruction: Search the Steam store for Portal 2 and add The Final Hours DLC to the shopping cart.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding Portal 2 in Steam store and adding The Final Hours DLC to cart. Uses existing is_added_to_steam_cart metric to verify cart content. Similar complexity to original Dota 2 task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'get_page_info' correctly navigates to Steam cart URL and extracts HTML content
Metric 'is_added_to_steam_cart' properly checks if expected DLC name exists in cart HTML content
Expected value 'Portal 2 - The Final Hours' is the correct official DLC name
Data flow is logical: cart HTML → string search for DLC name → pass/fail
Instruction requirement fully covered: verifies DLC is added to cart
No postconfig needed - cart state persists after task completion
